en: Forgive the intrusion.
I shall take my leave at once.
Oh, not at all, I assure you.
Some gentlemen do care about their hair.
Arthur, the hairdresser here, is young,
but he's very skilled. He's quite renowned.
I see. Then I shall try him another time.
Why, we met the other day, didn't we?
note: Follows #8316 on a new line; starts a sentence (dependency from slice 103).

en: Oh, you've come already, have you?
Well then, good day.
Oh, good day.
We meet again.
I have nothing else to do, you see,
so I'm always here.
Silly, isn't it?
There's nothing to do at home either
and nothing I care to say to my husband.
Arthur the hairdresser is my best company.
Oh, hello. Back again, are you?
Have you come to have your hair done?
The hairdresser here is simply marvelous.
Why don't you give him a try?
Oh, listen to me, I sound like a shopgirl.
Rather than living in luxury, working hard
seems somehow the better way to live
Seeing you is a welcome change.
My life is little more than a way to pass
the time, after all.
Perhaps I should find a hobby, too.
Tending my hair every day grows tiresome.
Hello. Who might you be?
Have you come to see my husband, Norman?
Norman is out at work.
He's rarely home at this hour.
I'm sorry. Please do call again.
If it's my husband you want,
why not try his office?
Hello. What brings you here today?
If I will do, shall I keep you company?
Every day is so dull, so very dull
I'll invite you to tea sometime.
Do come if you have the time.
We're well acquainted now, aren't we?
Do dine with us when my husband is home.
Our cook is excellent, you know.
Do tell me some interesting stories.
I'll be waiting.
If you are so very bored,
then I shall grant you a purpose.
Be my hands and feet, and labor for me
Oh,
To think you'd come all the way here.

en: excellent
Another servant.
How weak and fragile humans are.
Good day, madam.
We have not met, madam. The soft sunlight
suited you so, I couldn't help but speak.
My, so young and such a flatterer.
Being greeted by a lovely young man like
you isn't bad at all.
I'm Virginia. Pleased to meet you.
The pleasure is all mine.
Good day. I hope we meet again.
Please don't worry about it, madam.
To be greeted by such a beautiful lady
is an honor.

and I'll be leaving at once.
Oh, but you're here now.
